note: Original questions written in the style of graduate-scheme video interviews (e.g. HireVue). They are not copied from any company's question set.

questions.text: Why are you interested in this role, and why now?
What do you know about our business, and what attracts you to working here?
Where do you see your career in three years, and how does this role help you get there?
Tell us about a time you taught yourself something new because you were curious about it.
Describe a time you worked in a team that was not performing well. What did you do?
Tell us about a time you disagreed with a teammate. How did you handle it, and what was the outcome?
Give an example of when you had to rely on someone else to complete a task. How did you make sure it got done?
Describe a time you helped a team member who was struggling.
Tell us about a time you took the lead on something without being asked.
Describe a situation where you had to persuade others to support your idea.
Give an example of a time you had to make a decision that was unpopular.
Tell us about a complex problem you solved. How did you approach it?
Describe a time you had to make a decision with incomplete information.
Give an example of a process you improved. What changed as a result?
Tell us about a time you used data or evidence to change someone's mind.
Tell us about a time you failed. What did you learn from it?
Describe a time you received critical feedback. How did you respond?
Give an example of when you had several deadlines at once. How did you prioritise?
Tell us about a time plans changed at the last minute. How did you adapt?
Describe a time you had to explain something complicated to someone without the same background.
Tell us about a time you had to deliver bad news.
Give an example of a time a misunderstanding caused a problem. What did you do?
Tell us about a time you went beyond what was expected for a customer or client.
Describe a time you dealt with a difficult customer, client or stakeholder.
Tell us about a recent news story that affects our industry, and why it matters.
What do you think is the biggest challenge our industry will face in the next five years?
If you could launch one new product or service for us, what would it be and why?
Tell us about a time you noticed something that was not right. What did you do?
Describe a situation where you were under pressure to cut corners.
Tell us about yourself and the experiences that have shaped you.
What is your greatest strength, and how have you used it recently?
What is one area you are actively working to improve?
What achievement are you most proud of, and why?
Tell us about a time you worked with people whose background or views were very different from yours.
Describe a time you made sure everyone in a group had a chance to contribute.
